name: ACC Electronix, Inc
old_description: ACC manufactures ruggedized products that operate in the toughest environments
about:
ACC Electronix, Inc. was founded in 1981 in Normal, Illinois. The company operates as a manufacturer of electronic equipment, specializing in ruggedized products built for harsh environments.

The company provides a full range of electronics manufacturing services, including circuit card assembly (surface-mount and through-hole), full box build, product design and engineering, fulfillment, depot repair, and remanufacturing. Its production facility is configured to handle both hand-built prototypes and high-volume runs, with capabilities such as 0201 SMT placement, micro-BGA, 12-zone reflow ovens, X-ray inspection for BGA and BTC, 3D solder paste inspection, and automated through-hole assembly. Final assembly, testing, and cost management round out the offering.

ACC serves customers in construction and mining, agriculture, HVAC and industrial controls, and energy (solar and wind power systems). Testimonials on its site reference a major mining company and an agriculture OEM, indicating a base of original-equipment manufacturers that require rugged, high-reliability electronics.

The company emphasizes a “flexible and adaptable” workforce and equipment set, aiming to develop a custom formula for each customer’s quality, delivery, inventory, and cost goals. It operates to IPC A-610 Class 2 and 3 standards, with technicians certified to IPC J-STD-001 Rev G and IPC 7711/7721, and offers both RoHS-compliant and leaded soldering chemistries.
